question: How many customers are students?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_type = 'Student'

question: How many active products are in the Merchandise category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Merchandise' AND p.is_active

question: What is the most expensive textbook and its price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products WHERE product_type = 'Textbook' ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders have been refunded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Refunded'

question: What is the average list price of hoodies?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) FROM products WHERE product_type = 'Hoodie'

question: How many white jerseys do we have in stock across all sizes?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(v.stock_quantity) FROM product_variants v JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'Jersey' AND v.color = 'White'

question: How many alumni customers live in Illinois?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_type = 'Alumni' AND state = 'IL'

question: List the courses offered by the Kelley School of Business.
gold_sql: SELECT course_code, course_name FROM courses WHERE school = 'Kelley School of Business'

question: What was total revenue in March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: How many completed online orders were placed in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'Online' AND status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which clothing product type sold the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Clothing' AND o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY p.product_type ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which state other than Indiana has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE state <> 'IN' GROUP BY state ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show revenue by sales channel for 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel

question: What is the total value of our current inventory at cost?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(v.stock_quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) FROM product_variants v JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id

question: Which jacket brand has the highest average list price?
gold_sql: SELECT brand, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE product_type = 'Jacket' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed on November 28, 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-11-28' AND order_date < '2025-11-29'

question: Which textbook has sold the most copies?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS copies FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'Textbook' AND o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY copies DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which month in 2025 had the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most popular payment method among faculty and staff?
gold_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.customer_type = 'Faculty/Staff' GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active product variants are at or below their reorder level?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variants v JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.is_active AND v.stock_quantity <= v.reorder_level

question: How much revenue came from youth clothing?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.fit = 'Youth' AND o.status = 'Completed'

question: How many Game Day Kiosk orders were there in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'Game Day Kiosk' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: How much revenue did the 2025 Graduation Celebration promotion generate?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promotion_id = oi.promotion_id WHERE pr.name = 'Graduation Celebration' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.start_date) = 2025 AND o.status = 'Completed'

question: How many courses have more than one textbook assigned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT course_code FROM course_textbooks GROUP BY course_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

question: Which general (non-textbook) book generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'General Book' AND o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the gross margin percentage on Merchandise sales?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * (SUM(oi.line_total) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) / SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Merchandise' AND o.status = 'Completed'

question: Compare the average order value of students and alumni.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT o.order_id, cu.customer_type, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND cu.customer_type IN ('Student', 'Alumni') GROUP BY o.order_id, cu.customer_type) SELECT customer_type, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM t GROUP BY customer_type

question: Who are the top 3 Luddy School students by total spending?
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS spent FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE cu.customer_type = 'Student' AND cu.iu_school = 'Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering' AND o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was textbook revenue in August 2025 versus August 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.variant_id = oi.variant_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'Textbook' AND o.status = 'Completed' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) = 8 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY 1

question: What share of Game Day Kiosk revenue came from alumni, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE cu.customer_type = 'Alumni') / SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'Game Day Kiosk' AND o.status = 'Completed'
